- Despite my efforts to stay aggressive and focused on attacking, the lack of potions and the critical health level ultimately led to my downfall in the final turn.  
- It was a close match, and the strategic decision to attack in the last turns was a necessary risk, albeit one that didn't pan out in my favor.
